import requests, numpy as np, json, time

def parse_atom_site(text):
    lines=text.splitlines(); i=0; cols=[]; rows=[]; n=len(lines)
    while i<n:
        if lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'):
            while i<n and lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
            while i<n:
                ln=lines[i]
                if ln.startswith('#') or ln.startswith('loop_') or ln.startswith('_') or ln.strip()=='': break
                rows.append(ln.split()); i+=1
            break
        i+=1
    idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}; return idx,[r for r in rows if len(r)==len(cols)]
def load(pid): return parse_atom_site(S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=200).text)
def chain_atoms(st,chain):
    idx,recs=st; out=[]
    for r in recs:
        if r[idx['auth_asym_id']]!=chain or r[idx['type_symbol']]=='H': continue
        if r[idx['label_comp_id']]=='HOH': continue
        try: xyz=(float(r[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_z']]))
        except ValueError: continue
        out.append((int(r[idx['auth_seq_id']]),r[idx['label_comp_id']],r[idx['label_atom_id']],np.array(xyz)))
    return out
def seq_of(st,chain):
    seen={}
    for r,n,a,x in chain_atoms(st,chain):
        if n in AA3to1: seen[r]=AA3to1[n]
    ks=sorted(seen); return ks,"".join(seen[k] for k in ks)
def ca_map(st,chain): return {r:x for r,n,a,x in chain_atoms(st,chain) if a=='CA' and n in AA3to1}

Bm=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()] for l in b62.strip().split("\n")],float); AI={c:k for k,c in enumerate(hdr)}
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    sc=Bm[np.ix_([AI.get(c,0) for c in s1],[AI.get(c,0) for c in s2])]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        s=sc[i-1];Mi1=M[i-1];Xi1=Ix[i-1];Yi1=Iy[i-1];Mi=M[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a,b,c=Mi1[j-1],Xi1[j-1],Yi1[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mi[j]=a+s[j-1];pM[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mi[j]=b+s[j-1];pM[i,j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=c+s[j-1];pM[i,j]=2
            a,b,c=Mi1[j]+go,Xi1[j]+ge,Yi1[j]+go
            if a>=b and a>=c: Xi[j]=a;pX[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Xi[j]=b;pX[i,j]=1
            else: Xi[j]=c;pX[i,j]=2
            a,b,c=Mi[j-1]+go,Xi[j-1]+go,Yi[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Yi[j]=a;pY[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Yi[j]=b;pY[i,j]=1
            else: Yi[j]=c;pY[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; stt=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); out=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if stt==0: out.append((i-1,j-1)); ns=pM[i,j]; i-=1;j-=1
        elif stt==1: out.append((i-1,None)); ns=pX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: out.append((None,j-1)); ns=pY[i,j]; j-=1
        stt=ns
        if i<0 or j<0: break
    out.reverse(); return out
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,Sv,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt; return R,pc,qc
def apply_T(X,R,pc,qc): return (X-pc)@R+qc

t0=time.time()
st5=load("5B7I")
ks_pa,seq_pa=seq_of(st5,"A"); ca_pa=ca_map(st5,"A")
acr_atoms=[a for a in chain_atoms(st5,"B")+chain_atoms(st5,"C") if a[1] in AA3to1]
acr_prot=[141,196,197,198,202,227,228,229,230,236,239,240,242,244,245,249,252,254,697,699,873,876,878,879,880,883,884,889,890,891,948,949,950,951,969,970,972,975,976,977,980,998,1000,1005,1006,1007,1008,1009,1010,1011,1012,1059,1060,1061,1062,1074,1075,1076]

results={}
for pid, cas23_chain, csy_chains in [("8K22","A",{"Csy1":["B"],"Csy2":["C"],"Csy3":["G","I","J","K","L","M"],"Csy4":["H"],"Cas1":["D","E","d","e"],"DNA/crRNA":["P","Q","R","U","V"]}),
                                     ("8K24","A",{"Csy1":["B"],"Csy2":["C"],"Csy3":["G","I","J","K","L","M"],"Csy4":["H"],"Cas1":["D","E","d","e"],"DNA/crRNA":["P","Q","R","U","V"]})]:
    st=load(pid); ks_ic,seq_ic=seq_of(st,cas23_chain); ca_ic=ca_map(st,cas23_chain)
    pairs=nw(seq_pa,seq_ic)
    common=[(ks_pa[a],ks_ic[b]) for a,b in pairs if a is not None and b is not None]
    ic2pa={q:p for p,q in common}
    common=[(p,q) for p,q in common if p in ca_pa and q in ca_ic]
    P=np.array([ca_pa[p] for p,q in common]); Q=np.array([ca_ic[q] for p,q in common])
    # global superposition with trimming
    keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
    for it in range(12):
        R,pc,qc=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); d=np.linalg.norm(apply_T(P,R,pc,qc)-Q,axis=1)
        nk=d<max(4.0,np.percentile(d[keep],70))
        if nk.sum()<60 or (nk==keep).all(): break
        keep=nk
    rms_glob=float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(apply_T(P,R,pc,qc)-Q,axis=1)[keep]**2).mean()))
    # local superposition: only PaCas3 CA within 15 A of AcrIF3 interface residues
    acr_xyz=np.array([ca_pa[r] for r in acr_prot if r in ca_pa])
    loc=[k for k,(p,q) in enumerate(common) if np.linalg.norm(acr_xyz-ca_pa[p],axis=1).min()<15.0]
    Pl,Ql=P[loc],Q[loc]; keepl=np.ones(len(Pl),bool)
    for it in range(12):
        Rl,pcl,qcl=kabsch(Pl[keepl],Ql[keepl]); d=np.linalg.norm(apply_T(Pl,Rl,pcl,qcl)-Ql,axis=1)
        nk=d<max(4.0,np.percentile(d[keepl],70))
        if nk.sum()<40 or (nk==keepl).all(): break
        keepl=nk
    rms_loc=float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(apply_T(Pl,Rl,pcl,qcl)-Ql,axis=1)[keepl]**2).mean()))
    row={"N_global":int(keep.sum()),"RMSD_global":round(rms_glob,2),"N_local":int(keepl.sum()),"RMSD_local":round(rms_loc,2)}
    for tag,(RR,PC,QC) in {"global":(R,pc,qc),"local":(Rl,pcl,qcl)}.items():
        moved=apply_T(np.array([a[3] for a in acr_atoms]),RR,PC,QC)
        tot3=0; per={}
        for name,chs in csy_chains.items():

            if not T: continue
            tree=cKDTree(np.array([t[3] for t in T]))
            n3=sum(len(x) for x in tree.query_ball_point(moved,3.0)); per[name]=n3; tot3+=n3
        row[f"clash3_{tag}"]=per; row[f"clash3_{tag}_total"]=tot3
